remarks: Single-story pool home on a nearly quarter-acre cul-de-sac lot in Whittier! Featuring 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and approximately 1,373 square feet of living space, this property combines the convenience of single-level living with an expansive 10,357-square-foot lot. The private pool sets the stage for summer gatherings, relaxed weekends, and outdoor entertaining, while the generous lot offers possibilities for gardening, outdoor dining, and creating your own backyard retreat. Situated within the Fullerton Joint Union High School District and near Meadow Green Elementary and Rancho-Starbuck Intermediate, the location adds to the home’s appeal.
